tested: Exclusive connected noninheritable socket, two independently sequenced directions, closed protocol2 body grammar and exact Unicode/optional-null preservation.
Real Windows socketpair EOF/partial frame deadline/repeated cancellation; known socket-close success plus actual UNCANCELLED IO-task completion before closed=true.

32 real16KiB streamed engine events release consumed completed tasks/results/frame groups; pending or uncertain IO remains retained. EOF/cancel checks capture actual task references before pruning.

limits: Controlled socket.close exceptions are simulated faults around real sockets, not a claim that an OS close failure was independently induced.
The post-close-uncertainty negative leaves proof owner retained until enclosing process drain; passing tests do not mean all negative cases report successful cleanup.
No socket.share/fromshare, retained source process provenance, host/worker phase gate, durable ACK, native input delivery or full three-actor proof.
